text:
maya: Heads up — audit shows a KMS_DECRYPT from a shared service account into a customer org that should be isolated. looks like service-account:redwood-shared-sa@infra-prod accessed projects/customer-123 key. can infra take a look?

raid-bot: (automated) alert triggered: KMS_DECRYPT_ACROSS_ORG. resource=projects/customer-123/locations/global/keyRings/kr-1/cryptoKeys/customer-key. actor=serviceAccount:redwood-shared-sa@infra-prod. severity=high. link: https://audit.internal/audit/evt/0xabc123

devin: Is this the ingestion SA we use for metrics/log forwarding? If so it should never get resource-level KMS roles in customer orgs.

li: Confirming — found two RoleBindings referencing redwood-shared-sa in customer-123 via terraform drift. quick grep: `kubectl get rolebinding -A | grep redwood-shared-sa` returned: `rb-logs-customer-123  customer-123  role:roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter  subject:serviceAccount:redwood-shared-sa`

sasha: immediate mitigation: revoke the SA tokens in customer-123, rotate the customer key policy to remove the SA binding, and block the SA at the edge proxy. I'll start the key policy change.

ryan: putting a deny rule on the edge/ingress for any requests where actor.serviceAccount==redwood-shared-sa and resource.org_id!=actor.org_id. will push in next 5m and open a pager. also will add a realtime alert for any KMS_DECRYPT where actor.org != resource.org.

maya: Action list (owners):
- revoke cross-org tokens and block SA at proxy (ryan)
- remove RBAC RoleBindings and scan TF state for drift (sasha + devin)
- authz fix: enforce org_id assertion in token -> resource mapping (li + devin)
- rotate affected KMS keys / rotate customer key if requested (sasha)
- create P1 incident and notify customer success (maya)
Please update timelines inline.

devin: proposed short patch to authz check (pseudo):
```
# authz checker: require org scoping for KMS decrypt
if actor.type == 'serviceAccount':
  allow = (actor.attrs['org_id'] == resource.attrs['org_id']) and policy_allows(actor, action)
else:
  allow = policy_allows(actor, action)
```
We also need to validate OIDC/JWT includes org_id claim from all upstream tokens.

li: I'll add org_id to the service-auth token and KMS audit log export. also recommending we add an assertion in the gateway JWT middleware: `reject if jwt.org_id != requested_org`. Will open a PR for middleware patch and an integration test.

sasha: I found the terraform drift source — a shared module in infra-legacy that injects the SA binding when `enable_log_forwarding = true` and doesn't namespace the org. command used: `tfstate-query --path "modules.legacy.forwarding" --filter subject=redwood-shared-sa`
Suggests fix: update module to use `${var.org_id}` in role binding subject or disallow passing cross-org SAs.

maya: I've opened INC-2024-4523 and added initial notes + affected_customer=customer-123. severity P1. linking to this thread.

audit-bot: added evidence: 3 events in last 24h. event ids: [evt:0xabc123, evt:0xabc124, evt:0xabc125]. exported logs to https://audit.internal/export/INC-2024-4523.zip

ryan: revoked tokens and applied proxy deny rule. temporary mitigation done. seeing 0 new decrypt events now.

devin: started a scan across all orgs for any RoleBinding that grants cloudkms roles to shared SAs: `kubectl get rolebinding -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name=="redwood-shared-sa")'`
found 4 occurrences across staging and 2 customer orgs. adding remediation tickets.

li: PR for JWT middleware and authz tests opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/edge/pulls/9812. includes test harness to simulate cross-org decrypt attempts.

sasha: patch to legacy TF module incoming. will add strict validation on `enable_log_forwarding` and require passing `consumer_service_account` with org scoping.

maya: good progress. next: postmortem + long-term controls:
- policy: require `organization` attribute in all role bindings for KMS and critical resources
- infra: add terraform linting to catch cross-org bindings (pre-commit hook)
- observability: new alert rule for KMS_DECRYPT where actor.org != resource.org
- runbook: update RTO for cross-org leak to 1h and include key rotation playbook

sasha: question — do we inform the customer now or after keys are rotated? legal / cs decision.

maya: holding message to customer ops until we confirm no replay/unauthorized read. legal on call advised to prepare disclosure template.

devin: retrospective note: shared service accounts are convenient but dangerous. can we phase them out and use per-org service identities? I'll add to roadmap.

ryan: thumbs up on that. I'll keep the deny rule for 72h then transition to full authz check.

maya: ok closing immediate incident loop here. please paste status updates into INC-2024-4523 and mark remediation tickets done when completed. thanks all :eyes: :thumbsup:
